desc: 薄荷雾玻璃架加5000K顶光近无影，护翼巾体穹面屈曲与六边空栏收口
name: 薄荷雾玻璃架液体卫生巾款

shots.intent: 搜索第一眼：用一片屈曲在磨砂玻璃穹面上的巾体加同族平放片抢点击，替掉源首屏的奶黄麦草台、立柱与进口角标。
shots.textZone: upper-left headline line in #16493A plus one small latin sub-rail; one hairline #16493A hexagon outline with a centred dot at the headline head

shots.intent: 承接源页第2屏的三格情境卡：把烦恼短句与灰图位改成三枚完全空框，让买家自行代入，不用任何症状或功效句。
shots.textZone: one headline line above the cards plus one short empty rail under each card

shots.intent: 承接源页第3屏的定义框位：把「液体材料」解说与蓝色透明假想巾体改为同一架面同一顶光下的两片同机位对照，只留空栏不下结论。
shots.textZone: one blank base rail per panel plus one section line above the divider

shots.intent: 把源页第4屏的四枚功能引线改成可实拍的边廓厚度研究：只交代巾体弯折时自身的轮廓与缝点，删掉反锁、极薄与毫米数断言。
shots.textZone: four hairline dot-terminal rails at the right, brackets only

shots.intent: 承接源页第5屏的轻透薄三字圆标：改为三枚六边形点芯标加发丝引线，只做面层压纹与薄荷芯区的本真微距，不写透气孔数与毫米数。
shots.textZone: three bracketed label slots beside three hexagon nodes plus one section line at the head

shots.intent: 承接源页第6与第7屏的三张真人紧身裤实拍：整块弃用人体，改为三格纯静物时位暗示，只保留一处失焦肩线作尺度锚。
shots.textZone: one section line above the top shelf plus three empty bracketed label rails, one per frame

shots.intent: 把源页未给的选款诉求落在同族多片同框上：型号差异完全交给参考图自身承载，不发明片数、长度与日夜标签。
shots.textZone: one short blank rail under each unit, brackets only

shots.intent: 承接源页第7与第8屏的三条 Q&A：把气味解释、荧光增白剂、FDA与厚生劳动省与断裂渗漏断言整块剥离，改为三枚六边形问号位的空栏答疑。
shots.textZone: one section line above the panel plus six empty ruled slots read as bracketed labels

shots.intent: 收口：以深林绿玻璃架夜版把整组收在一条主张与一个空动作位上，不用促销、时长建议与统计元素逼单。
shots.textZone: lower band, one bracketed line plus one empty action slot

style.backgroundSystem: one continuous system of horizontal matte frosted-glass shelf planes #F7FAF8 with hairline #CFE3D8 edge reveals and a soft mint haze field #E4F1E9 behind them; clean colourless still water beads sit only on the glass, never on the product, and stay beaded rather than running; closing screens may swap the haze for a matte deep forest #16493A panel while the glass shelf stays in the lower third. Never a photographed bathroom, never tile, never wood, never linen or towelling, never a paper field or printed grid, never a wheat or straw bed, never a fluted cream column, never a pink or peach gradient, never a cloud or petal or sparkle field, never a blue translucent gel render standing in for the pad.
style.direction: airy mint-and-matte-glass commerce for feminine care
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight #16493A hexagon outlines, each with one small centred #16493A dot; hairline #16493A leader lines ending in a small filled dot, straight or one-step elbow, used as the only connector; hexagons stay empty inside apart from their centred dot; no check marks, no crosses, no arrows implying a test result, no leaves, no shields, no droplet pictograms, no filled badges, no certification seals, no numerals, no gradient or 3D icons.
style.lightingSystem: one large diffuse overhead source directly above the shelf at 5000K, near shadowless: objects keep only a tight soft darkening directly beneath their contact line and at most one short faint pooling shadow, never a long cast or raking shadow; a weak mint bounce from below the shelf edge keeps the pad face open; clear droplets and the matte glass edge read as soft broad glints, never hard streaks or a wet mirror; the light direction is identical in all nine screens and the product always touches the glass with a believable contact, never floating.
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent airy mint-and-matte-glass visual system for feminine-care e-commerce across the entire image set; fixed palette of matte glass-shelf field #F7FAF8, pale mint haze #E4F1E9, glass shadow #CFE3D8, deep forest green #16493A and one mint core accent #A9DCC8; neutral 5000K treatment; one light-to-regular geometric sans family with a wide-tracked headline plus one small latin sub-rail, Chinese copy always inside 「」 brackets only; background system limited to a horizontal matte frosted-glass shelf carrying clean colourless still water beads, a soft mint haze behind it and one plain matte deep forest panel on the closing screen, never a bathroom, never tile, wood, linen, paper grid, wheat or straw, never a pink gradient, never clouds or petals; lighting system of one large diffuse overhead source at 5000K that is near shadowless, keeping only a tight soft contact darkening and at most one short faint pooling shadow, never a long cast or raking shadow, always a believable contact and never a floating product; surfaces limited to matte frosted glass, one low matte dome, one plain deep forest panel and the pale mint haze, no marble, wood, paper, fabric or liquid surface; icon system of thin single-weight #16493A hexagon outlines each holding one small centred dot, with hairline #16493A leader lines ending in a small filled dot as the only connector, no check marks, no arrows, no badges, no certification seals, no numerals; the pad keeps its reference hourglass outline, scalloped wing form, dotted perimeter bonding, quilting arcs, mint #A9DCC8 centre zone and colourway, flex is shown exactly as the reference shows it with one pad curved over a low matte dome, and no outer packaging is invented if the reference does not show one; product is always a clean glass-shelf pad study, never on or against a body, never on underwear, at most one out-of-focus cropped shoulder line with no face and no hands; every claim slot, hexagon and rail stays empty; no palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no change of light direction, no long shadows, no mismatched icon styles, no medical or antibacterial claim, no hypoallergenic or gynaecologist-tested wording, no material or core composition, no absorbency or thickness figure, no size or count numerals, no registration or certification mark, no import badge, no price or QR code.

style.presentationRules: the pad keeps the reference hourglass outline with a rounded head, two scalloped shell-edged wings, the dotted bonding line running the whole perimeter, the concentric quilting arcs near the head, the mint #A9DCC8 centre zone and the colourway exactly; flex is shown the way the reference shows it, one pad curved over a low matte dome with its wings hanging free; no outer bag, carton or count badge is invented, an inner wrapper appears only if the reference image actually shows one; products are photographed as clean glass-shelf pad studies, never worn, never held, never on or against a body, garment or underwear; human presence is abstract and non-identifiable, at most one out-of-focus cropped shoulder line at a frame edge with no face, no arm and no hand; vertical pack edges stay strictly vertical; every claim slot, hexagon and rail stays empty.
style.surfaceSystem: matte frosted glass shelf #F7FAF8 with a #CFE3D8 edge reveal, one low matte frosted-glass dome, a plain matte deep forest #16493A panel, and a pale mint haze field #E4F1E9; the pad itself renders true to the reference, matte non-woven face with fine quilting arcs, dotted perimeter bonding and a mint #A9DCC8 centre zone, never glossy, never wet, never blue tinted; no marble, no wood, no paper card, no fabric, no straw or grain bed, no liquid surface or puddle.
style.typography: one light-to-regular geometric sans family; a wide-tracked headline set bare in #16493A on the mist or reversed out of a solid #16493A bar, with one small latin sub-rail beneath it; short bracketed label slots only, generous leading, no dense body paragraphs, no outlined bubble lettering, no narrow condensed grotesque, no serif, no handwriting.
